mapper.select: SELECT apr17_corp_doc_id AS corp_doc_id , apr17_call_date AS call_date , apr17_call_emp_nm AS call_emp_name , apr17_provide_co AS provide_co , apr17_purpose AS purpose , apr17_stamp_cert_call_cnt AS stamp_cert_call_cnt , apr17_corp_reg_call_cnt AS corp_reg_call_cnt , apr17_reg_date AS reg_date FROM (SELECT * , f_emp_kor_nm(apr17_call_emp_id) AS apr17_call_emp_nm , ( SELECT count(*) FROM apr18_relate_corp_doc INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = apr18_appr_id WHERE apr18_corp_doc_id = apr17_corp_doc_id ) AS apr17_appr_cnt , ( SELECT count(*) FROM apr18_relate_corp_doc INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = apr18_appr_id WHERE apr18_corp_doc_id = apr17_corp_doc_id AND apr01_status_cd = '40') AS apr17_appr_reject_cnt FROM apr17_corp_doc WHERE apr17_company_id = #{companyId} AND apr17_reg_date IS NULL AND ( COALESCE(apr17_stamp_cert_call_cnt,0) != 0 OR COALESCE(apr17_corp_reg_call_cnt ,0) != 0 )) t WHERE CASE WHEN apr17_appr_cnt != 0 THEN apr17_appr_cnt != apr17_appr_reject_cnt ELSE TRUE END ORDER BY apr17_call_date DESC

SELECT a.apr18_relate_corp_doc_id AS relate_corp_doc_id , a.apr18_corp_doc_id AS corp_doc_id , a.apr18_appr_id AS appr_id , b.apr01_title AS title , b.apr01_reg_date AS reg_date , b.apr01_effect_date AS effect_date , f_emp_kor_nm(b.apr01_reg_emp_id) AS reg_emp_name , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', b.apr01_status_cd, b.apr01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS status_name FROM apr18_relate_corp_doc a INNER JOIN apr01_appr b ON b.apr01_appr_id = a.apr18_appr_id INNER JOIN apr17_corp_doc c ON c.apr17_corp_doc_id = a.apr18_corp_doc_id WHERE a.apr18_corp_doc_id = #{corpDocId} AND c.apr17_company_id = #{companyId}
SELECT apr17_corp_doc_id FROM apr17_corp_doc INNER JOIN apr18_relate_corp_doc ON apr18_corp_doc_id = apr17_corp_doc_id WHERE apr18_appr_id = #{apprId} GROUP BY apr17_corp_doc_id
SELECT count(*) FROM apr17_corp_doc WHERE apr17_corp_doc_id = #{corpDocId} AND apr17_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apr18_relate_corp_doc ( apr18_relate_corp_doc_id, apr18_corp_doc_id, apr18_appr_id ) VALUES ( #{relateCorpDocId}, #{corpDocId}, #{apprId} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM apr18_relate_corp_doc WHERE apr18_corp_doc_id IN ( SELECT apr17_corp_doc_id FROM apr17_corp_doc WHERE apr17_company_id = #{companyId} ) AND apr18_relate_corp_doc_id IN #{id}
